card.name: Small connecting words in citations and history
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation ("of", "(", ",", a space before a date) inside bibliography entries and history passages, often in titles like "Culture of Poverty".

modes.label: Citation titles
modes.description: The word "of" or a quote mark or parenthesis inside a reference entry for a book or article.
modes.example: Lewis, Oscar (1996 (1966)). "The Culture<< of>> Poverty". In G. Gmelch

modes.label: History narrative
modes.description: Ordinary connecting tokens in historical prose about politics, such as the Pentagon Papers or Nazi Germany.
modes.example: Hitler outlaw<<ed>> strikes and abolished independent labor unions.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated foreign and code fragments.
card.plain: It fires on small glue words and punctuation in reference lists and history writing, not on any one topic word.
